title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,901–1,950 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: The airplane flew smoothly above the thick white clouds.
examples.zh: 飛機在厚厚的白雲上方平穩地飛行。

examples.en: Yushan's peak rises nearly four thousand meters above sea level.
examples.zh: 玉山主峰聳立於海拔近四千公尺的雲天之巔。

examples.en: Please write your full name clearly in the space provided above.
examples.zh: 請在上方預留的空白橫線上端正書寫您的中文全名。

examples.en: Temperatures in high mountains often drop below zero in winter.
examples.zh: 高山地區冬季氣溫經常驟降至零度以下。

examples.en: Look at the photo gallery printed below to identify local wetland birds.
examples.zh: 請詳加參閱下方印製的彩色圖鑑，辨識常見的在地濕地水鳥。

examples.en: Divers swam down below the water's surface to photograph coral fish.
examples.zh: 潛水員深潛至波光粼粼的水面下方，拍攝穿梭珊瑚礁間的熱帶魚群。

examples.en: We sat resting beneath the shade of an old banyan tree.
examples.zh: 我們坐在老榕樹的樹蔭底下乘涼休息。

examples.en: A network of underground utility pipes runs beneath the city streets.
examples.zh: 繁複交錯的地下水電管線網絡深埋在都會區街道的正下方。

examples.en: Beneath her shy, quiet demeanor lies a fiercely determined competitive athlete.
examples.zh: 在她生性害羞靦腆的外表底下，其實藏著一顆堅毅無比的競賽好勝心。

examples.en: She sat beside her best friend during the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮上她坐在最好的摯友身旁。

examples.en: Place the floor lamp beside the armchair so you can read comfortably.
examples.zh: 把立式閱讀燈擺設在單人扶手沙發身旁，這樣看書才夠明亮舒服。

examples.en: Beside the massive Pacific Ocean, our tiny boat felt small and fragile.
examples.zh: 與浩瀚無邊的太平洋相比，我們搭乘的觀光小艇顯得格外渺小脆弱。

examples.en: Besides English, many Taiwanese students also learn Japanese or Korean.
examples.zh: 除了英語之外，許多台灣學生也學習日語或韓語。

examples.en: What hobbies do you enjoy on weekends besides playing computer video games?
examples.zh: 週末除了窩在家裡打電腦電玩以外，你平時還喜愛哪些休閒嗜好？

examples.en: I don't feel like going out tonight; besides, a storm is brewing outside.
examples.zh: 我今晚實在不太想出門吃宵夜；而且更何況外頭正颳風下雨呢。

examples.en: The beauty of Taroko Gorge is beyond words.
examples.zh: 太魯閣峽谷的壯麗美景令人難以言喻。

examples.en: The hiking trail extends far beyond that green ridge into the deep forest.
examples.zh: 登山健行步道一路延伸至那座翠綠山脊的更遠處，深入濃密黑森林。

examples.en: Fixing this complex database crash is frankly beyond my current technical ability.
examples.zh: 搶修這起錯綜複雜的資料庫崩潰事故，坦白講遠遠超出了我目前的能力。

examples.en: Bubble tea is hugely popular among international exchange students.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶在國際交換學生群體中極受歡迎。

examples.en: We strolled happily among ancient red cypress trees in the Alishan forest.
examples.zh: 我們漫步在阿里山神木林間，穿梭矗立在數千年紅檜巨木群之中。

examples.en: The generous lottery winner divided his fortune equally among five local charities.
examples.zh: 慷慨的大樂透得主將大部分中獎彩金平均分配捐贈給五家在地慈善機構。

examples.en: The high-speed rail runs swiftly between Nangang and Zuoying.
examples.zh: 高鐵在南港與左營兩站之間快速奔馳。

examples.en: Choose between oolong tea and black tea to pair with your afternoon pineapple cake.
examples.zh: 在清香烏龍茶與濃郁紅茶兩者之間做出選擇，搭配可口的午後鳳梨酥。

examples.en: There is a deep, unbreakable bond of trust between the two business partners.
examples.zh: 這兩位創業夥伴之間存在著極其深厚、堅不可摧的無條件信賴默契。

examples.en: Pedestrians walked safely across the crosswalk.
examples.zh: 行人安全地穿過行人穿越斑馬線。

examples.en: The graceful suspension bridge spans across the scenic turquoise river valley.
examples.zh: 這座造型優雅的景觀吊橋橫跨在碧綠如玉的美麗深山溪谷上方。

examples.en: We sat at a seaside cafe across the street watching the waves roll in.
examples.zh: 我們坐在街道正對面的露天濱海咖啡廳，靜靜凝望著海浪拍打沙灘。

examples.en: We rode YouBikes along the Tamsui River cycling path.
examples.zh: 我們騎著 YouBike 沿著淡水河畔的自行車道悠閒騎行。

examples.en: Cherry blossoms bloomed gorgeously all along the winding mountain road.
examples.zh: 盛開的粉嫩櫻花沿著整條蜿蜒起伏的山區公路兩旁一路美艷綻放。

examples.en: Bring your younger sister along with us when we visit the science museum!
examples.zh: 咱們下午去科教館參觀常設展時，把妳可愛的小妹妹也一道帶上吧！

examples.en: The train sped through the long mountain tunnel into Yilan.
examples.zh: 火車飛速穿過長長的山脈隧道駛入宜蘭。

examples.en: Sunlight filtered softly through the bamboo leaves onto the stone trail.
examples.zh: 金黃色的晨曦陽光穿透層層竹葉縫隙，溫柔灑落在青石健行步道上。

examples.en: He achieved academic success through sheer perseverance and daily dedication.
examples.zh: 他完全是憑藉著堅定不移的過人毅力與日復一日的苦讀，取得了學業成就。

examples.en: Convenience stores operate twenty-four hours throughout Taiwan.
examples.zh: 便利商店在全台灣各地全天候二十四小時營運。

examples.en: The audience maintained complete and respectful silence throughout the piano recital.
examples.zh: 在整場鋼琴獨奏會演奏進行的自始至終，全體聽眾保持著肅穆與專注。

examples.en: Famous night market food stalls attracted cheerful crowds throughout the entire year.
examples.zh: 這家知名夜市排隊名攤在整整一整年當中，始終吸引著絡繹不絕的熱絡人潮。

examples.en: The tourists walked toward the Taipei 101 observatory entrance.
examples.zh: 遊客們朝著台北 101 觀景台入口走去。

examples.en: Taking twenty daily vocabulary quizzes is an encouraging step toward English mastery.
examples.zh: 每天堅持完成二十題單字測驗，是朝向精通英語目標邁出的踏實一步。

examples.en: She always maintains a gentle and compassionate attitude toward stray animals.
examples.zh: 對待街頭流浪受苦的弱小動物，她始終抱持著溫柔體貼與憐憫的關懷態度。

examples.en: She poured fresh warm soy milk into her ceramic mug.
examples.zh: 她把新鮮熱豆漿倒入陶瓷馬克杯中。

examples.en: The inquisitive child peered excitedly into the deep marine aquarium tank.
examples.zh: 好奇心旺盛的小朋友興高采烈地把臉貼在巨型水族箱玻璃上往裡頭張望。

examples.en: Over the past decade, the modest fishing harbor evolved into a popular tourist destination.
examples.zh: 過去十年間，這座質樸的小漁港逐漸轉變發展成為極受歡迎的觀光勝地。

examples.en: The cute stray cat jumped onto the warm wooden bench.
examples.zh: 可愛的小流浪貓跳上了溫暖的木質長凳。

examples.en: The confident singer stepped proudly onto the concert stage to loud applause.
examples.zh: 滿懷信心的歌手在全場如雷的熱烈掌聲中，昂首闊步登上了巨星演唱會舞台。

examples.en: Rain droplets splashed steadily onto the metal corrugated roof during the afternoon storm.
examples.zh: 午後雷陣雨傾盆而下時，冰涼的大雨滴劈啪作響地濺落在鐵皮屋頂之上。

examples.en: You can reach the night market within a ten-minute walk.
examples.zh: 步行十分鐘之內即可抵達夜市。

examples.en: All submitted homework assignments must be turned in within the designated deadline.
examples.zh: 所有課堂作業與期末專案報告，皆必須嚴格在規定的繳交截止期限之內繳齊。

examples.en: Peaceful happiness comes from cultivating inner contentment within your own mind.
examples.zh: 真正的內心寧靜與平靜喜樂，來自於在自己的心靈深處耕耘知足與感恩。

examples.en: Never enter a construction zone without wearing a safety helmet.
examples.zh: 未佩戴安全帽切勿進入施工工地區域。

examples.en: We navigated the winding mountain backroads successfully without a GPS map.
examples.zh: 在沒有衛星定位導航的情況下，我們憑著路標成功穿過了蜿蜒的深山小徑。

examples.en: She completed the demanding half-marathon course without stopping to rest once.
examples.zh: 她跑完了極具挑戰性的半程馬拉松賽事，全程連一次停下來休息都沒有。

examples.en: Lean your umbrella against the shoe cabinet near the door.
examples.zh: 把你的雨傘靠在門口的鞋櫃旁。

examples.en: Citizens voted overwhelmingly against the proposal to tear down the historic library.
examples.zh: 全體市民以壓倒性票數投票，強烈反對拆除這座具有百年歷史的古蹟圖書館。

examples.en: Wearing a sturdy waterproof jacket provides great protection against bitter winter winds.
examples.zh: 穿上一件厚實硬挺的防水防風機能外套，能為你提供抵禦冬日寒風的絕佳防護。

examples.en: The post office is located directly opposite the MRT exit.
examples.zh: 郵局就座落在捷運出口的正對面。

examples.en: Hot and cold are clear examples of opposite descriptive adjectives in English.
examples.zh: 「熱」與「冷」在英文基礎詞彙中是極為典型的反義對立形容詞範例。

examples.en: I thought he would agree enthusiastically, but he surprisingly did the exact opposite.
examples.zh: 我原以為他會熱情滿滿舉雙手贊同，未料他的實際舉止卻恰恰完全相反。

examples.en: Let's grab lunch at a nearby noodle shop.
examples.zh: 我們去附近的一家牛肉麵館吃午餐吧。

examples.en: Is there a public restroom or convenience store nearby where I can wash my hands?
examples.zh: 這附近是否有公共洗手間或便利商店，可以讓我稍微洗洗雙手嗎？

examples.en: Neighborhood children play soccer on the nearby elementary school sports field.
examples.zh: 住在附近的社區小朋友們，放學後常在旁邊的國小操場草地上踢足球。

examples.en: Although it rained heavily, the outdoor concert continued enthusiastically.
examples.zh: 雖然下著滂沱大雨，戶外演唱會依然熱情開唱。

examples.en: Although she was exhausted after work, she still cooked a healthy dinner for her family.
examples.zh: 儘管下班後身心感到十分疲憊，她依然堅持親手為家人烹煮一頓營養晚餐。

examples.en: Although modern technology connects us instantly, deep human relationships take patience.
examples.zh: 雖然當代科技能讓人們瞬間即時互聯，但真摯深刻的人際連結仍需耐心經營。

examples.en: The climb was exhausting; the mountain view was stunning, though.
examples.zh: 爬山過程很累人；不過山頂的風景真是絕美無比。

examples.en: Even though he had never visited Taipei before, he navigated the MRT with ease.
examples.zh: 即便他在此之前從未造訪過台北，他依然能毫不費力地輕鬆搭乘捷運趴趴走。

examples.en: I haven't heard from him in weeks; I am sure he is doing well, though.
examples.zh: 雖然我已經好幾個禮拜沒收到他的音訊了；不過我深信他一定過得很好。

examples.en: I wanted to go jogging; however, it started pouring rain.
examples.zh: 我本想出門慢跑；然而，天公不作美下起了傾盆大雨。

examples.en: The team practiced tirelessly every weekend; however, they lost the final match by one point.
examples.zh: 該校隊每個週末都夜以繼日刻苦集訓；然而，他們在總決賽中以一分之差惜敗。

examples.en: However difficult the coding challenge seems, break it down into smaller functions.
examples.zh: 無論這道程式演算法難題看似多麼棘手，只要將其拆解為細小函式即可迎刃而解。

examples.en: He practiced every day; therefore, he passed the English speaking test easily.
examples.zh: 他每天勤奮練習；因此，他輕鬆通過了英語口說測驗。

examples.en: The flight was overbooked; therefore, the airline offered travel vouchers to volunteers.
examples.zh: 該航班機位出現超賣；因此，航空公司主動向自願改搭旅客提供機票抵用券。

examples.en: Regular exercise strengthens cardiovascular health; therefore, doctors advise walking daily.
examples.zh: 規律運動能增強心肺與心血管功能；因此，專業心臟科醫師極力建議每日健走。

words.definition: 否則；要不然；在其他方面

examples.en: Set your alarm clock, otherwise you might oversleep tomorrow.
examples.zh: 設定好你的鬧鐘，否則你明天可能會睡過頭。

examples.en: Wear a warm thermal jacket, otherwise you will catch a chill in the mountain wind.
examples.zh: 請務必穿上一件保暖發熱衣，否則在吹拂的深山陣陣冷風中你一定會著涼感冒。

examples.en: The soup was a little salty, but the dinner banquet was otherwise absolutely flawless.
examples.zh: 那道湯品口感稍微偏鹹了一點，但在其他所有方面，今晚的宴席堪稱無可挑剔。

examples.en: The hotel is affordable; moreover, it is close to the night market.
examples.zh: 這間飯店價格實惠；此外，它還緊鄰夜市。

examples.en: Cycling daily cuts carbon emissions; moreover, it tones your legs and burns calories.
examples.zh: 每天騎自行車通勤能減碳愛地球；再者，它還能緊實雙腿肌肉並燃燒多餘熱量。

examples.en: The applicant speaks fluent English; moreover, she possesses five years of coding experience.
examples.zh: 這位應徵者不僅能說一口極其流利的英語；此外，她更擁有整整五年的實務編程經驗。

examples.en: In addition to free Wi-Fi, the hostel offers free morning breakfast.
examples.zh: 除了免費無線網路之外，這家青年旅館還提供免費早餐。

examples.en: In addition to high salaries, the technology company provides comprehensive health coverage.
examples.zh: 除了具備競爭力的高薪之外，這家知名科技企業還提供涵蓋全家的健全健保福利。

examples.en: She loves playing badminton; in addition, she swims thirty laps every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 她非常熱愛打羽毛球；此外，每逢週日早晨她還會雷打不動地到泳池游三十趟。

examples.en: He studied diligently; as a result, he achieved top grades.
examples.zh: 他用功苦讀；因此，他取得了名列前茅的優異成績。

examples.en: The bridge suffered structural damage from the flood; as a result, traffic was rerouted.
examples.zh: 這座大橋在暴雨洪水中遭受了結構性損壞；結果，所有往來車輛被迫改道通行。

examples.en: She ate a balanced diet and slept eight hours; as a result, her energy levels soared.
examples.zh: 她維持均衡天然的清淡飲食並睡滿八小時；結果，整個人的精神活力大幅提升。

examples.en: Taiwan has many scenic peaks; for instance, Yushan and Hehuanshan.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多壯麗的高山；例如，玉山與合歡山。

examples.en: Citrus fruits, for instance oranges and grapefruits, are rich sources of vitamin C.
examples.zh: 柑橘類水果，舉例來說像柳橙與葡萄柚，都是富含天然維他命 C 的極佳來源。

examples.en: You can incorporate micro-habits into your routine; for instance, reading ten pages nightly.
examples.zh: 你可以在日常作息中融入微習慣；舉例來說，每晚睡前堅持翻閱閱讀十頁好書。

examples.en: We didn't take a taxi; we walked to the museum instead.
examples.zh: 我們沒有搭計程車，而是選擇走路去美術館。

examples.en: Don't waste energy complaining about the rainy weather; read a captivating book instead.
examples.zh: 別再把寶貴的精神力氣耗費在抱怨陰雨連綿的天氣上；反之，不妨捧讀一本好書。

examples.en: He decided not to buy a new smartphone and invested the savings in index funds instead.
examples.zh: 他打消了換購全新旗艦手機的念頭，轉而將省下來的這筆錢全數投入指數基金。

examples.en: Choose water instead of sugary sodas for better health.
examples.zh: 為了身體健康，請多喝白開水代替含糖汽水。

examples.en: Take the stairs instead of the crowded elevator to get a quick cardio workout.
examples.zh: 選擇走安全梯步級代替搭乘擁擠的電梯，順道為自己安排一次快速的心肺有氧。

examples.en: She decided to cook dinner at home instead of spending money eating out at a diner.
examples.zh: 她決定今晚親自下廚在家做飯，而不是花大錢到外頭的昂貴餐廳外食消費。

examples.en: The outdoor baseball game was postponed due to torrential rain.
examples.zh: 戶外棒球賽因為豪大雨而被迫延期舉行。

examples.en: Due to unforeseen mechanical problems, the train will arrive twenty minutes late.
examples.zh: 由於突發未料的機械機件故障問題，本次列車抵達終點站將會稍微延誤二十分鐘。

examples.en: The shop’s remarkable success was largely due to its warm, attentive customer service.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙小鋪之所以能取得令人矚目的成功，很大程度上得益於其親切周到的客服。

examples.en: Flights were temporarily delayed because of thick sea fog.
examples.zh: 航班因濃密海霧而暫時延誤起飛。

examples.en: The street concert was relocated indoors because of sudden afternoon thunderstorm warnings.
examples.zh: 由於氣象局發布了突發性午後大雷雨特報，街頭音樂會緊急移師至室內大廳舉行。

examples.en: She chose to study computer engineering because of her lifelong passion for video games.
examples.zh: 她之所以毅然決然選擇鑽研電腦資工，完全是起因於從小對電子遊戲的無限熱愛。

examples.en: Thanks to your kind assistance, we finished the science project on time.
examples.zh: 多虧了你的熱心協助，我們才能按時完成科展專案。

examples.en: Thanks to modern high-speed rail, traveling between Taipei and Kaohsiung takes ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 幸虧有了現代化的高速鐵路，現在南北往返台北與高雄兩地僅僅只需九十分鐘。

examples.en: Thanks to early medical detection, the patient recovered completely from the illness.
examples.zh: 多虧了醫療儀器的早期篩檢與精準診斷，該名病患才得以從病痛中完全奇蹟康復。

examples.en: In spite of the cold wind, we enjoyed our coastal stroll.
examples.zh: 儘管寒風刺骨，我們依然很享受海邊漫步的時光。

examples.en: He won the national table tennis tournament in spite of a lingering shoulder strain.
examples.zh: 儘管飽受肩膀拉傷舊疾的隱隱作痛困擾，他依然在全國桌球錦標賽中強勢登頂。

examples.en: In spite of repeated failures during experiments, the scientist refused to abandon her theory.
examples.zh: 儘管在實驗室研發過程中歷經了無數次的挫敗，這位科學家堅決不放棄自己的理論。

collocations: in spite of the fact that

examples.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be sunny and warm.
examples.zh: 根據氣象預報，明天將會是晴朗溫暖的好天氣。

examples.en: Assemble the bookshelf according to the step-by-step illustrations in the manual.
examples.zh: 請嚴格依照組裝說明書上標示的一步一步圖解步驟，組裝這座實木書架。

examples.en: According to recent public surveys, young professionals value work-life balance highly.
examples.zh: 依據最近出爐的各項民意問卷調查，當今年輕在職人士極度看重工作與生活的平衡。

examples.en: You can achieve your goals as long as you stay persistent.
examples.zh: 只要持之以恆，你一定能夠實現自己的目標。

examples.en: You may borrow my bicycle as long as you promise to return it before sunset.
examples.zh: 只要你保證在今天傍晚太陽下山前物歸原處，你隨時都可以借騎我的公路自行車。

examples.en: As long as we stand united and support one another, no hardship is insurmountable.
examples.zh: 只要我們彼此團結一心、守望相助，世間便沒有任何無法跨越克服的艱難險阻。

examples.en: Call me as soon as you arrive safely at the station.
examples.zh: 你一平安抵達車站就馬上打電話給我。

examples.en: As soon as the final school bell rang, cheerful students dashed out onto the playground.
examples.zh: 當放學鐘聲劃破校園的那一瞬間，雀躍開朗的學童們立刻蜂擁奔向操場嬉戲。

examples.en: I will send you the updated PDF report as soon as the team finishes editing it.
examples.zh: 只要我們團隊把最後的文字排版校對完畢，我會第一時間立刻將更新後的 PDF 寄給您。

examples.en: The breakfast set includes scrambled eggs as well as fresh fruit juice.
examples.zh: 這份早餐套餐包含炒蛋以及新鮮現榨果汁。

examples.en: She speaks fluent Japanese as well as conversational Spanish and French.
examples.zh: 她不僅能說一口流利道地的日語，同時還具備西班牙語與法語的日常會話能力。

examples.en: The workshop teaches practical coding techniques as well as effective team collaboration.
examples.zh: 本次研習工作坊不僅傳授實用的編程實作技術，同時亦深刻培養高效團隊協作技巧。

examples.en: Let me know whether you can attend the farewell party tonight.
examples.zh: 請讓我知道你今晚是否能夠出席歡送派對。

examples.en: Whether it rains or shines, the annual marathon race will take place as scheduled.
examples.zh: 無論當天天候是艷陽高照還是刮風下雨，一年一度的馬拉松大賽都將如期舉行。

examples.en: He couldn't decide whether to study computer engineering or fine arts at university.
examples.zh: 他一時之間難以抉擇，上大學後究竟該專攻電腦資訊工程還是純藝術創作。

examples.en: We won't go on a picnic unless the weather clears up.
examples.zh: 除非天氣放晴，否則我們不會去戶外野餐。

examples.en: You cannot enter the airport boarding gate unless you show a valid passport and ticket.
examples.zh: 除非您主動出示本人的有效護照與實體或電子登機證，否則將無法進入登機門。

examples.en: Unless we take urgent action on climate change, extreme storms will become even more severe.
examples.zh: 除非我們各國當前針對氣候變遷採取果斷緊急行動，否則極端暴風災情將愈發嚴峻。

words.definition: 當…的時候；然而；一段時間

examples.en: Listen to English audio while commuting on the MRT every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上搭乘捷運通勤時聽英文廣播。

examples.en: While my sister loves spicy hot pot, I prefer mild herbal chicken soup.
examples.zh: 然而我姐姐極度嗜吃麻辣火鍋，我個人卻偏好清甜甘醇的溫和藥膳雞湯。

examples.en: Sit down and rest a while on the park bench after your long jog.
examples.zh: 跑完漫長的一大圈晨跑之後，不妨在公園的木質長凳上坐下來稍微歇息片刻。

examples.en: Some people love sweet tofu pudding, whereas others prefer savory styles.
examples.zh: 有些人喜歡吃甜豆花，然而有些人則偏好鹹豆花。

examples.en: Walking downhill requires little aerobic effort, whereas climbing uphill demands high stamina.
examples.zh: 沿著平緩斜坡下山幾乎毫不費力，反之上山攀登則需要極為充沛的耐力體能。

examples.en: Modern phones charge in under an hour, whereas older cell phones took all night.
examples.zh: 當代旗艦智慧手機能在不到一小時內充飽電，反之傳統舊式手機往往得充上一整夜。

examples.en: Since you are already here, let's have dinner together.
examples.zh: 既然你都已經來了，那我們就一起吃頓晚餐吧。

examples.en: He has lived in Kaohsiung ever since he graduated from university eight years ago.
examples.zh: 自從八年前從大學順利畢業之後，他就一直長年定居生活在陽光明媚的高雄。

examples.en: Since the mountain path is muddy and slick, watch your footing carefully.
examples.zh: 既然雨後的陡峭山徑十分泥濘濕滑，健行時請務必步步為營、留心腳下安全。

examples.en: Study hard until you achieve complete mastery of the grammar rules.
examples.zh: 努力用功讀書，直到你完全掌握文法規則為止。

examples.en: We waited under the arcade awning until the heavy thunderstorm finally stopped.
examples.zh: 我們靜靜站在騎樓遮雨棚下耐心避雨，直到窗外滂沱的大雷雨終於漸漸止歇。

examples.en: The night market stalls stay bustling with cheerful customers until two in the morning.
examples.zh: 這處知名觀光夜市的熱門小吃攤位熱鬧滾滾，熱絡氣氛一直持續到凌晨兩點為止。

examples.en: Feel free to reach out whenever you encounter English questions.
examples.zh: 每當遇到英文疑問時，隨時歡迎向我請教。

examples.en: Whenever I smell fresh roasted coffee beans, I think of peaceful weekend mornings.
examples.zh: 每當我聞到空氣中飄散的現磨烘焙咖啡香氣時，總會不自覺聯想到恬靜的週末晨光。

examples.en: You are warmly welcome to visit our cozy community bakery whenever you are in town.
examples.zh: 無論何時只要你來到我們小鎮，我們都無比竭誠歡迎你造訪這間溫馨的社區麵包坊。

examples.en: You can easily find convenience stores wherever you go in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣無論走到哪裡，都能輕易找到便利商店。

examples.en: True friends will stand by you and support you wherever life's journey takes you.
examples.zh: 無論人生旅途的風雨將你帶往何方，真正的摯友永遠都會堅定站在身旁支持著你。

examples.en: Keep your portable passport and wallet secure wherever you travel abroad.
examples.zh: 前往海外各地自助旅行時，無論置身何處，務必隨時妥善保管好護照證件與隨身皮夾。

examples.en: Choose whichever dessert you like best from the menu.
examples.zh: 從菜單中挑選你最喜歡的任何一道甜點吧。

examples.en: Take whichever train arrives first; both lines stop directly at Taipei Main Station.
examples.zh: 無論哪一班列車先到站就搭哪一班，因為這兩條捷運路線都會直達台北車站。

examples.en: Pick whichever study method suits your learning style, whether flashcards or audiobooks.
examples.zh: 無論是單字卡還是有聲書，挑選任何最契合你個人學習風格的有效讀書方法即可。

examples.en: Whatever challenge you face, remember to do your best.
examples.zh: 無論面臨什麼挑戰，請記得全力以赴。

examples.en: You can order whatever drink you want from the tea shop menu; it’s my treat today!
examples.zh: 這家手搖茶飲菜單上的任何品項你儘管隨便點，今天這頓全由我來買單請客！

examples.en: Whatever happens during tomorrow's championship finals, be proud of your hard work.
examples.zh: 明天的總冠軍決賽無論最終勝負結果如何，都請為自己長久以來的刻苦付出感到驕傲。

examples.en: Whoever finishes the reading first can start writing the reflection.
examples.zh: 無論是誰先讀完文章，都可以先開始撰寫心得。

examples.en: Whoever left their umbrella in the conference room can retrieve it at the front desk.
examples.zh: 無論是誰把深藍色折疊雨傘遺留在會議室裡，都可隨時前往一樓總服務台認領。

examples.en: The generous scholarship is open to whoever demonstrates academic excellence and leadership.
examples.zh: 這筆優厚的全額獎學金，向所有展現卓越學術研究潛力與領袖特質的學子全面開放。
